meta.problem: Brands make green claims faster than regulators can check them; I want an agent that checks a brand's environmental claims against independent evidence and real rulings, and keeps watching a list of brands every day.

agent.name: Judge (coordinator) + Prosecutor + Defender
agent.model_rationale: Sonnet over Opus: a public demo with per-visitor runs, so speed and cost (~$1–1.50 per multi-agent run) matter more than the last bit of quality.
agent.system_summary: Judge reads brand memory, delegates the case against to Prosecutor and the case for to Defender (multiagent_20261001, predefined subagents only), weighs both, gives each claim holds up / unsubstantiated / misleading with the rule, updates brands/<slug>.md, writes /mnt/session/outputs/report.json and ends with a JSON block.
never_dos: Never allege intent or dishonesty beyond what a cited ruling found
Never cite the EU Green Claims Directive as law
Never touch rotation.md outside a scheduled rotation run
Never contact brands or post anywhere: research and assessment only

subagents.name: Prosecutor
subagents.role: strongest independent evidence against each claim

rubric_criteria:
Does every assessed claim quote the brand's own words, with a fetched URL and date?
Does every verdict (holds up / unsubstantiated / misleading) cite at least one independent source that contradicts or supports it, plus the relevant rule (UK CMA Green Claims Code, ASA CAP Code, EU Directive 2024/825 / UCPD, FTC Green Guides, or a national court ruling)?
Is the wording defamation-safe: framed as "our assessment", with no allegations of intent or dishonesty beyond what a cited ruling found, and with "unsubstantiated" used where evidence is lacking?
Was brand memory used: brands/<slug>.md read (if present) and updated with the last-checked date, verdicts and what changed? Rotation applies ONLY if the kickoff says "scheduled rotation run": then exactly the next brand in rotation.md was processed and the index advanced. On any other run, rotation.md must be untouched; do not penalise the absence of rotation.
Is the EU Green Claims Directive (if mentioned) described accurately as a pending proposal, not law, and are there no fabricated rulings or URLs?
Is every claim that a regulator or court has ruled on rated misleading or unsubstantiated, for a reason consistent with that ruling?
outcome.max_iterations_note: 1 instead of the skill default 3: public demo with a $3 per-session budget cap

stores.name: Greenwash Brand Memory
stores.purpose: One file per brand (brands/<slug>.md: last checked, verdicts, what changed) + watchlist.md (40 brands) + rotation.md (next index) for the daily run.

environment.name: greenwash-watch-env-open
environment.note: limited networking with empty allowed_hosts blocked web_search/web_fetch, so unrestricted + bash disabled

schedule.human: Every day at 08:00 Stockholm time, one brand from the watchlist rotation
schedule.kickoff: user.message: scheduled rotation run (relative dates only)

evals.notes: Every case is a real, verified regulator or court ruling from docs/evals.md. innocent, persil and klm run first; the rest are held back as a regression check.

defaults_applied.write_actions: None: the agent only researches and writes its own memory

interface.how: https://nevolin.be/greenwashing-watchdog/ — live SSE timeline per agent, steering buttons, debate view, under-the-hood diagram; Console for traces.

next_directions.why_deferred: Needs weeks of daily runs in memory
next_directions.how: Second deployment 0 9 * * 1 reading brands/*.md, writes leaderboard.md

next_directions.what: Slack/email alert when a brand turns misleading
next_directions.why_deferred: Write action + credential not on hand
next_directions.how: Mock outbox first; then Slack MCP + vault, always_ask

next_directions.why_deferred: limited + empty allowed_hosts blocks web tools

next_directions.what: Re-run evals before promoting a version
